name: PS5 Ebook Reader
description: Native PS5 homebrew ebook and comic reader with support for EPUB, PDF text preview, CBR and CBZ. Features a TV-friendly bookshelf interface, real book and comic covers, EPUB illustrations, DualSense navigation, favorites, persistent reading progress, single and double-page layouts, zoom and pan up to 400%, USB book discovery and importing, resumable transfers, loading progress bars and exit confirmation.
author: YAHBALLON
